claims.text: The case has 917 evidence windows in 36 episodes, from 09:08 to 15:10.

Outlet pressure was outside its baseline band in 336 windows over 4 episodes; the highest score was 33.9 (band 42.6 to 43.2 bar).
Pump acceleration peak was outside its baseline band in 1 window over 1 episode; the highest score was 7.44 (band 12.2 to 33.5 m/s²).

Scores are robust band exceedances, not calibrated probabilities, and CIRA has no fault labels, so the data cannot establish a fault.
Replay scores use declared per-day inputs (A8) and fixed settling times (A7).
